summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GPS Lock feature for tour welcome screen. All backend APIs pass (19/19 tests). Frontend GPS features work correctly in admin editor and player. GPS check section properly blocks tour start until location is verified.

'Use My Location' button present and triggers geolocation API
Manual lat/lng input fields work correctly and accept decimal values
GPS settings save to database correctly via API

Player welcome screen shows GPS check section when GPS is enabled
Player 'Check My Location' button triggers geolocation API

GPS coordinate precision maintained in database
